verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of provider-agnostic model configuration, an LLM abstraction layer, or any mechanism for swapping models/providers without code changes; it focuses on graph structure, persistence, streaming, and deployment. Missing for 10: any documentation of a model-provider abstraction (e.g., init_chat_model or similar), examples of switching providers, or community confirmation that agent logic is decoupled from a specific LLM.
